recreation_brief:
1. Set the entire slide background to a flat light gray fill #f0f0f0 (no gradient).
2. Draw a thin red (#c0392b) rectangular outline, no fill, inset slightly from the slide edges, framing the content area.
3. Draw a thin solid black (#000000) horizontal strip flush with the very bottom edge of the slide, spanning the full slide width.
4. In the top-right corner (approx 5% x 5% zone), draw a small yellow (#f1c40f) circle with a thick black (#000000) outline containing the black numeral '8'.
5. In the upper-middle area (approx 35%-80% of slide width, 10%-40% of slide height), draw a beige (#e8e0d0) filled rectangle as the neural-network diagram container.
6. Inside the container along its far-left edge, draw a vertical column of small purple (#8e44ad) dots (input layer; exact count not specified in source).
7. Draw black arrows fanning from the purple dots to a vertical column of blue (#3498db) circles, each circle containing a black sigma 'Σ' symbol.
8. Add small black (#2c3e50) labels 'Net', 'O', and 'w' beside the blue nodes/connections.
9. Draw black arrows from the blue Σ column to a vertical column of green (#2ecc71) circles, each containing a black 'Σ' symbol; align these nodes one-to-one with the three output labels in step 11.
10. Add small black (#2c3e50) labels 'Net', 'O', and 'w' beside the green nodes/connections, mirroring step 8.
11. Immediately to the right of the green Σ column, stack three black (#2c3e50) text labels vertically, top to bottom: 'Output 1', 'Output 2', 'Output m'.
12. Draw curved black arrows arching over the top of the green nodes, connecting the output nodes to each other.
13. At the bottom-left inside the container, place a purple (#8e44ad) dot next to the black text 'Multi Bias'.
14. At the bottom-center inside the container, place left to right: an upward-pointing black arrow, a purple (#8e44ad) circle containing the numeral '1', and a second upward-pointing black arrow.
15. To the right of the beige container (approx 80%-85% of slide width, matching the container's vertical extent), draw a vertical red (#c0392b) rectangle with the word 'Error' in white (#ffffff) vertical text.
16. Immediately to the right of the red bar, stack three black (#2c3e50) labels vertically, top to bottom: 'Class 1', 'Class 2', 'Class m'.
17. At the far right (approx 88%-95% of slide width, vertically centered on the diagram), add black (#2c3e50) text '∂E/∂w_ij' (with 'ij' subscripted) followed immediately by a large red (#c0392b) question mark '?'.
18. Do NOT add any slide title, subtitle, header, or bullet text — the source slide contains none; leave the area below the diagram container (approx 40%-100% of slide height) as empty light gray #f0f0f0 except for the black bottom strip from step 3.
